content.value: A cylindrical pressure vessel is fabricated from steel plating that has a thickness of 20 mm. The diameter of the pressure vessel is 450 mm, and its length is 2.0 m. Determine the maximum internal pressure that can be applied if the longitudinal stress is limited to140 MPa, and the circumferential stress is limited to 60 MPa.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
